assessmentPoints: Completing-the-square answers in the opening activity
Worksheet and exit-ticket answers in the closing activity
successCriteria: Completing the square, as area - x^2 + 6x is an x-by-x square plus two 3-by-x strips, and the missing 3-by-3 corner of area 9 completes the square.
objectives.text: Complete the square for a quadratic such as x^2 + 6x using the area picture

assessmentPoints: Discriminant answers in the second activity
Trap answers in the fourth activity
Worksheet and exit-ticket answers in the closing activity
successCriteria: The discriminant decides the roots - D = b^2 - 4ac: positive means two crossings, zero means one touch, negative means the curve misses the real axis.
A common mistake: a negative discriminant means no solution - no real roots is not no solution, because the two roots are complex.
objectives.text: Use the discriminant D = b^2 - 4ac to decide how many real roots a quadratic has

assessmentPoints: Inequality answers in the third activity
Worksheet and exit-ticket answers in the closing activity
successCriteria: Quadratic inequalities on a number line - find the roots -2 and 2 for x^2 - 4 > 0, then test each region to get x < -2 or x > 2.
objectives.text: Solve a quadratic inequality by finding the roots and testing each region of the number line
